title: S56-r2 row-stream schema freeze
purpose: Define the frozen row-stream schema for the fp64 tuple test (stage 1) record; every tuple-row artifact (results/tuple_fp64.json) MUST conform to this schema. No claim about the row-stream is written without this schema in the package.

rows.description: Exactly 9 tuple rows (C=384, k=3, s=1, d in 1..4, pad=p, H=W=7, batch=2, seed 4321)

time.description: Wall/device time per row (device time via torch.cuda.Event)

binding_rules: No claim about the row-stream is written without this schema in the package.
rows must have exactly 9 items (one per frozen grid point).
fp64_error fields are REQUIRED on every row (admission criterion: data present).
class_32 and class_64 are REQUIRED (they determine the flip verdict).
verdict is derived: flip iff class_32 != class_64 OR fp64 rho_max/med > eps (1e-6).

acceptance.rows_at_eps: count of rows where class_32 != class_64 OR fp64/med > 1e-6
acceptance.admission_rule: p_accept >= 0.8 AND the three criteria (contract, diagnostic, admission) hold at the recorded realization.
criteria: contract: each row's expected_h matches F.conv2d output shape (exact, not fuzzy).
diagnostic: fp64_error present on all rows; rho_max > 0 for every row.
admission: p_accept >= 0.8 AND no unclassifiable rows.
